title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Empresa está contratando Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Toptal  is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand. A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert  is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries. The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements. The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions. Task and deliverables:  Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization. Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools. Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules. Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities. Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response. Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices. Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries. Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team. Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.  Required experience:  Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience. Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts. Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation. Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases. Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development. Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation. Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance. Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team. Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams. Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.  Engagement highlights:  Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries. Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design. Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de inglês em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!  Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade. Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis. Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades. Visão geral da posição  Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos. Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula. Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos. Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas. Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas. Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.  Formato  Contratação:  Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) Local : Remoto Carga Horária:  Você define a sua própria agenda  Requisitos  Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1) Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial). Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula. Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo). Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal. Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso. Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online. CNPJ / MEI ativo.  Por que se juntar à nós?  Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida. Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional. O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais. Responsabilidades e atribuições  Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI; Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores; Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs; Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs); Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders; Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade; Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI; Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas; Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas; Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis; Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.  Requisitos e qualificações:  Obrigatórios  Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação; Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance; Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados; Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores; Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.  Desejáveis  Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI; Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.); Experiência em Data & Analytics; Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT); Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma); Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.  Diferenciais do perfil  Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI; Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional; Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio; Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.  Sobre a empresa  Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.  Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role  We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis. Responsibilities:  Manage large amounts of incoming tickets. Provide support to answer inquiries on products. Accept and handle technical requests. Triage tickets to the other teams. Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools. Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication. Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents. Take the extra mile to engage customers. Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.  Skills And Qualifications:  A Bachelor’s degree completed 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support roles Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion. Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics. Attention to detail is key to this position. Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs. Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills. Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).  Why Join JoVE?  A competitive compensation package. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

description:

Overview  We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities  Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.  Requirements  Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Empresa está contratando Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos?  Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real. Requisitos Obrigatórios:   Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs:  Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência. Experiência com Azure AI Foundry:  Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry. Experiência com Copilot Studio:  Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros) Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud:  Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.  Diferencial:   Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light); Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA; Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless; Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA; Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility); Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA; Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações; Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas; Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate); Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform); Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);  Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente; Contratação CLT O que oferecemos?  Vale Refeição ou Alimentação; Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica; Auxílio creche; Convênio com Farmácia; Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas; Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência; Gympass; Seguro de Vida;  Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.  Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.   Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!  Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:   O Grupo Capital:  Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes. Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar. Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.  Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos. Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l: A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital. Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática. Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades:  Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.   Pré-requisitos:  Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.  Diferencial:  Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.  Você terá:  Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership  estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.  Modo de contratação:  Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital  Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Power Electronics PCB Design Expert
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Power Electronics PCB Design Expert em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview  We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert  to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies. Key Responsibilties  Design power electronic circuits  including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems. Create schematics and PCB layouts  using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent. Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements. Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability. Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data. Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews. Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity.  Required Skills  Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components) . Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout.  Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar) . Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection. Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices .  Preferred Skills  Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics. Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools. Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks. Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows).  Qualification  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering  or related field. 5+ years  of experience in power electronics and PCB design .  Key Compentencies  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and design quality. Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams. Effective communication skills.

title: Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:

About HCLTech  HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving. The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership. Key Responsibilities:  Advanced English  • Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers. • Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks. • Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements. Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus) • Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT. • Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks. • Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups. SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:  o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based) o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:   o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures o CDS Views (where applicable) • Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance. • Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy. Reporting & Analytics:  Oversee reporting solutions using:   o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable) • Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain). Migration & Modernization:  Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including: o Readiness checks and simplification item handling o Remediation of custom code and data models o Data volume management and performance validation • Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective. Production Support & Governance • Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution. • Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation. Team & Stakeholder Leadership:  • Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers. • Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers. • Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Experiência com definição de landing zones de dados em Azure. Vivência em projetos com AI, Generative AI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Machine Learning ou MLOps. Experiência com FinOps, gestão de custos cloud e otimização de workloads. Conhecimento em frameworks de governança, segurança e conformidade, como LGPD, ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou similares. Experiência em comunidades técnicas, chapters, guildas ou centros de excelência.

Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Topology and Geometry  Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.  Analysis  Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.  Probability and Statistics  Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.  Applied Mathematics  Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges. description:

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

You enjoy solving problems across frontend, backend, and database. You thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment. You care about clean code and great user experience. You want Flex-time and Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results). You want an opportunity to work closely with leadership and gain cross-functional experience in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.  If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

Administrar condições comerciais nos sistemas de cada negócio, seguindo as regras estabelecidas nas políticas comerciais.

Estamos sempre buscando descobrir como fazer melhor nossas atividades, com isso buscamos pessoas que desejam estar sempre aprendendo e melhorando constantemente. Preparar os materiais e insumos para realização de suas atividades; 2. Separação e identificação de materiais conforme pedido do cliente, bem como sua movimentação; 3. Realizar o armazenamento correto de cada produto; 4. Manejo de equipamentos de acordo com sua estação de trabalho; 5. Realizar conferências, com objetivo de inventário, garantindo qualidade e registro adequado do produto; 6. Efetuar o carregamento e descarregamento de veículos; 7. Organização da área de trabalho; 8. Cuidado e zelo com os equipamentos de trabalho utilizados; 9. Utilização dos equipamentos adequados, garantindo a sua segurança e de colegas de trabalho.
